verdict.rationale: Milvus documents a native full-text search feature that accepts raw text and automatically converts it into sparse embeddings inside the database, so no external search engine is needed. Hybrid search is listed as a core feature, including in Milvus Lite, and a community comment cites hybrid and sparse-vector search as differentiators. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of keyword-relevance scoring (e.g., BM25), analyzer/tokenization details, and independent hands-on corroboration of full-text search quality.
